analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($126.52) vs SMA5/20/50($129.53/$138.49/$145.49): Below short/mid-term trends, diagnosed as weak position.
· Position vs SMA100/200($145.95/$134.47): Diagnosing mid-to-long-term trend strength as weak.
· 52-week position (54.4%) + Current price level historically intermediate.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (46.7→36.8): Entered oversold territory, downward momentum continues.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.3311→-1.2384): Weakness persists, worsening phase.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower $122.16): Approaching lower band, volatility maintained with band width at 23.58%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($114.63): Support based on Pivot S2.
· Swing Resistance ($145.93): Resistance based on SMA100, potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Sideways range, no clear Higher Low or Lower High identified.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.35x): Contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: Accumulation phase, entry contingent on RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement confirmation.
